items.title: Doc Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 28, 1995
items.q: I’ll play with Wynton, Wynton likes me so much.

ctx.x: I think that’s half of it.
Yeah I’m having a good time. I’m playing. I don’t care who I play with. I’ll play with Wynton, Wynton likes me so much.
Yeah, I saw you on T.V. with him.
